environment: Built Sites Worker preview at http://127.0.0.1:4323

desktop.result: A saved Direction C project rendered before any catalogue request. Opening Library issued a catalogue request. A deliberately intercepted first attempt returned synthetic HTTP 503; the project remained rendered and the UI explained that resource discovery and replacement were unavailable. Clicking Retry loaded the catalogue and displayed Gold runtime resources.

catalogueAttempts.source: synthetic fetch interception; no upstream request

mobile.result: The same saved project reopened in mobile Workbench Preview. The document width remained 390 CSS pixels with no horizontal overflow. The resource inspector and replacement dialog were usable; the full-height dialog kept its close button focused, and its candidate preview was scrollable within the preview frame.

deployedVerification.result: The defect remains reproducible on the public v30 Site at both desktop and mobile when the initial catalogue response is synthetically replaced with HTTP 503.
deployedVerification.fixStatus: awaiting approved deployment of a version containing the fix
limitations: The injected 503 simulates catalogue failure; it is not an upstream service outage.
The Sites-injected inline bootstrap CSP console error is tracked separately as AUD-342.
